notes: Born-digital monotonic chemistry teaching material. The residue flags are real Latin list markers 'a) b) c) d)' (21-36) and chemical formulas (H2S, CCl4, O2, Br2), all present in the print. Subscripts are flattened inline (3 'H2O', 9 'CCl4'), which is consistent across lines. Chlorine is read as 'CI'/'ICI' (18, 24, 25, 35, 40), but in this sans-serif font capital I and lowercase l are pixel-identical, so this is not a visible error; an optional fix is 'ICI'→'ICl' and 'CI'→'Cl'.
